definition: Rafael Rafailov is the lead author of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
details: Co-invented DPO at Stanford, simplifying LLM alignment by optimizing policy models directly on preference data without a separate RL reward model.

explainer.lead: Rafael Rafailov is an artificial intelligence researcher.
explainer.knownFor: Notable works include Direct Preference Optimization: Your Language Model is Secretly a Reward Model.
